lessons_control.note: pre_lessons is each hunter's own sum before it read researcher_us/LESSONS.md. edge_resolve.py ranks it against the same realised move as the key, which is the only thing that can tell the guidance file apart from a habit.

language_control.note: RETIRED 2026-09-22: the European and Canadian hunters now run one bilingual pass and emit no freeze, so this is 0/0 on every run sealed after that date. On earlier runs pre_local is each hunter's own sum after the ENGLISH pass and before the local pass; eu_resolve.py ranks it against the same realised move as the key, per market, and does not pool the UK (where the second pass varied source locality) with Germany and France (where it varied language).

note: Ranked on impact_sum: the hunters' signed per-finding sizes, added up, in points of spot. No call and no threshold -- cut wherever you like afterwards, which is what keeps the ranking question answerable at every k. `conviction` (abs of the key) is where the direction skill lives: over all events the sign is a coin flip, above the median conviction it is 74%. conviction_floor is a floor on emphasis in the note, never a filter on this file. Everything under `diagnostics` was measured as neutral or subtractive and decides nothing -- see researcher_us/EDGE_ANALYSIS.md.

findings.finding: Investar, the closest Baton Rouge peer (BFST is also headquartered in Baton Rouge), reported Q3 2026 on 2026-10-22, after BFST last spoke. NIM rose 6 bps to 3.73%; GAAP EPS was $0.74 and core EPS $0.77 against a ~$0.75 consensus. This points to margin still widening for south Louisiana commercial banks through Q3, which is the line BFST's $0.71 to $0.74 consensus step depends on (Q2 NIM was 3.73%, +8 bps).
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: In Q2 (2026-07-23, amc) BFST printed NIM +8 bps with core EPS $0.71 roughly in line, and the stock moved +2.26%. Its +6.88% (2025-10-23) and +8.84% (2025-01-23) reactions both followed margin-led quarters, per the baseline history.

findings.finding: Home Bancorp, the Lafayette LA peer that overlaps BFST's Acadiana footprint, missed Q3 2026 on credit (released 2026-10-19). Six relationships totaling $19.5M moved to nonaccrual, nonperforming assets rose to $53.7M (1.49% of assets) from $39.2M, and EPS was $1.28 against a $1.51 consensus. Credit is the line BFST sold off on in April 2026 (-4.42%). BFST's own NPAs fell to $109.2M (1.23% of assets) in Q2, and management guided to further NPL reductions.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: 2026-04-27 (bmo): -4.42%, the quarter with Q1 NPAs at $123.1M. 2026-07-23: +2.26% when NPAs fell to $109.2M on a $21.0M resolution.

findings.finding: Deposit costs turned up in the Gulf South and Texas in Q3 after the Fed's 25 bp hike on 2026-09-16, its first since 2023. Hancock Whitney's deposit costs rose 12 bps to 1.55%, and it guided Q4 to a similar or larger rise, above its July signal of about 10 bps for the half. Third Coast (Texas) saw interest-bearing deposit costs go from 3.41% to 3.49% and NIM fall 13 bps. Home Bancorp's rose 5 bps. BFST pays a high 2.88% on interest-bearing deposits and its Q2 margin gain leaned on cheaper deposits (from 2.95%). Its call assumed only 'no further rate cuts', not a hike.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: BFST's margin commentary has driven its larger moves (+6.88% Oct 2025, +8.84% Jan 2025). No hiking-cycle reaction exists in the 7-print baseline.

findings.finding: The call guidance this print is measured against goes beyond what consensus seems to embed. Management targeted high single-digit annualized loan growth in Q3 and Q4, falling core expenses, and a 1.25% ROA exiting Q4, against 1.05% core ROAA in Q2. On ~$8.9B of assets, 1.25% is roughly $27-28M a quarter, or about $0.80+ diluted EPS before preferred dividends, versus a $0.74 Q3 bar. Whether Monday reaffirms or walks back that trajectory is the guidance line.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: After Q2's guide (2026-07-23) the stock moved +2.26% and three analysts raised targets (Stephens $34 to $36, Hovde $32.50 to $36, DA Davidson $33 to $35; https://www.marketbeat.com/instant-alerts/business-first-bancshares-nasdaqbfst-price-target-raised-to-3500-2026-07-27/).

findings.finding: AT&T's Q3 2026 release (8-K, 2026-10-21) beat on adj. EPS ($0.65 vs ~$0.60) and revenue ($32.3bn vs $31.7bn) and raised the 2026 adj. EPS outlook to the '$2.40 range'. Postpaid phone net adds were 379k against ~387k expected and 405k a year earlier, phone churn was 0.92% (flat YoY), and the release says promotional discounts on subscriber additions partly offset pricing. The stock still fell about 5-6% that day and VZ fell 3.2% in sympathy. The peer that printed after VZ last spoke had a beat-and-raise sold, with the market focused on satellite competition, the capex cut and a $2.6bn impairment.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: VZ's own last 7 prints all reacted positive (median |move| 2.26%, +5.84% on the Q2 2026 beat-and-raise). The peer print shows the current tape selling a telecom beat-and-raise, which is a different reaction function from VZ's own history.

findings.finding: At Goldman Sachs Communacopia on 2026-09-09, with about two-thirds of Q3 elapsed, CEO Schulman committed to three things: Q3 would be the first quarter in at least three years with positive phone net accounts; 2026 postpaid phone net adds would land at the TOP end of the 750k-1M guide (about 761k needed in H2 against 184k in Q2); and churn would keep improving YoY with no 'phones on us'. The comparison quarter (Q3 2025) was 44k phone net adds. A CEO giving this specific a promise this late in the quarter implies he could see the numbers. The risk is that the bar is now set at a pace far above Q2.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q2 2026 (184k phone adds, best Consumer Q2 in five years, guide raised) reacted +5.84%. Q1 2026 reacted +1.55%. The Jan 2026 print with the first Schulman guide reacted +11.83%. Subscriber delivery has been bought every time under this CEO.

findings.finding: SpaceX agreed on 2026-10-08 to buy Grain Management's nationwide 800 MHz low-band spectrum (about $8bn reported; needs FCC approval) for Starlink Mobile. VZ fell 10.1% on 2026-10-09 to $41.65, of which about $0.71 was the ex-dividend, and sell-side targets were cut (Scotiabank to $50; JPMorgan 49->47 and RBC 46->44 per secondary reports). The Q3 period ended before the deal, so the print cannot show any satellite effect. The 10-26 call is management's first chance to rebut it with October churn and porting data. Schulman already argued on 2026-09-09 that LEO satellite cannot compete where 95-98% of Verizon revenue sits.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No prior print has had a satellite overhang. AT&T faced the same overhang on 10-21, reassured nobody and fell. That bounds the upside of a rebuttal.

findings.finding: Verizon's iPhone 18 Pro launch offer (preorders from 2026-09-12) gives up to $1,200 off a $1,199.99 phone with an eligible trade-in and a new line on a qualifying myPlan, or up to $1,020 off for existing customers who upgrade, paid as 36-month credits. That is effectively a free flagship for a switcher, against the CEO's 'no phones on us' line. It supports late-Q3 gross adds and churn but adds promotional cost to Q4 margins and ARPA. AT&T also flagged promotional discounts on additions.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No VZ-specific history found on promotional-cost surprises. Under the prior CEO, promo-heavy quarters with weak adds were sold (the Q3 2025 44k quarter still reacted +2.26% because of the CEO change).

findings.finding: The Oct 26 print is very unlikely to carry ALTITUDE-AD topline. Enrollment of 542 completed on 2025-03-26 and the double-blind period is 80 weeks (investor-day slide 32). ClinicalTrials.gov NCT06335173 carries an estimated primary completion of 2026-10. On 2026-10-22 the company restated 'topline results are expected in late 2026' and booked only baseline/qualitative posters at CTAD (Nov 16-17). So last-patient-last-visit is around now and data most plausibly lands in Dec 2026. The release should be a reiteration, possibly confirming LPLV or narrowing the month. It arrives after the stock bounced ~20% from ~$1.69 to $2.03 in the week the early report date was announced (Oct 26, against mid-November in prior years).
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No prior print on this name carried a topline-timing change. Its seven 8-K 2.02 reactions were +1.6, -3.5, -3.0, -1.0, -11.3, 0.0, +6.0 (median |3.0|), five of seven flat or down. Q2 2026, a reiteration of 'late 2026', moved +1.6%.
